title: Exploring New Business Formats of Original IP + AI Comic Dramas: Shuqi Chinese Network to Invest Another 300 Million Yuan in 2027 to Strengthen Ecosystem Synergy
excerpt: Recently, the 2026 Annual Creators Conference of Shuqi Chinese Network was held in Yixing, Jiangsu. Facing the industry trend of AI accelerating content product
content_html:
Recently, the 2026 Annual Creators Conference of Shuqi Chinese Network was held in Yixing, Jiangsu. Facing the industry trend of AI accelerating content production, the platform announced that it will invest 300 million yuan in 2027 to deepen its original content ecosystem and upgrade its support policies for comic dramas. To date, Shuqi has opened more than 100,000 novel IPs for creators to adapt and use. This is also a continuation of Shuqi's sustained investment in the original content ecosystem after its 2023 pledge to "invest 1 billion yuan over the next three years."

As AI tools increasingly run through the entire chain of creation, adaptation, and production, online literature is accelerating its expansion into new audiovisual formats such as comic dramas. While efficiency has risen sharply, how to uphold the bottom line of premium content has become a focus of the industry.

Wang Wei, General Manager of the Content and Intelligent Marketing Reading Business at Alibaba's Qwen Business Unit, said that original content has always been the industry's most important asset. Through continued creative support, the platform hopes to fully respect the value of "people" in creative production, allowing creators to focus more energy on the story itself and produce high-quality works that can transcend cycles and hold long-term value.

Data shows that the integration of high-quality online literature IPs with the comic drama format is growing into a vibrant new digital cultural business. At present, Shuqi has worked with more than 100 professional partner institutions and creators across multiple categories. Adapted comic dramas have exceeded 60 billion total online views, and annual revenue sharing for related ecosystem creators reached 150 million yuan in 2026.

To lower the entry threshold for small, medium, and micro creative teams, Shuqi, in addition to opening more than 100,000 long- and short-form original IPs, also provides about 400 adapted scripts free of charge each month through its professional screenwriting team. Through industry collaboration, some partner institutions have completed more than 400 comic drama adaptations within a year and achieved 10 billion-level view counts, driving content development from single hit works toward serialization and long-term operation.

Looking ahead to 2027, Shuqi's new 300 million yuan investment will focus on four major areas: original signing support, premium content incubation, AI-driven efficiency across the entire chain, and all-domain distribution. While deepening its presence in the domestic market, Shuqi is relying on multiple mainstream domestic and overseas channels to advance multi-path distribution, expanding the international reach and commercial conversion space for Chinese original stories.

In response to the infringement pain points constraining the healthy development of the industry, Shuqi is simultaneously strengthening its copyright protection system, combining technical measures with judicial rights protection, and continuing special governance against text piracy, unauthorized adaptations, and comic drama reposting, so as to protect the bottom line of original value.

High-quality original content is not only the foundation for the development of online literature but also an important source for the digital content industry to continue innovating and expanding IP value. As funding, technical tools, and copyright protection form a joint force, the deep integration of online literature and emerging audiovisual formats is moving toward a new stage of high-quality development.
